open_points.subject: A18 post-start symbolic links for the SQLite database and journal
open_points.text: “The database file and its journal are opened by SQLite ... and the kernel does not watch them after it” contradicts the unchanged formal invariant “symlink_inside(data_directory) -> refused”.
open_points.question: Does the formal invariant exclude the database and journal after startup, or must a post-start symbolic link at either path still be detected and refused?
options: Exclude SQLite-managed database and journal paths from the invariant after startup
Require detection and refusal of post-start links at the database and journal paths
open_points.default_guess: Treat the detailed normative rule as controlling: check the database and journal at startup but do not detect later replacement, and narrow the formal invariant accordingly.
